_comment: Scenarios that do not yet pass, keyed by test name, with why. 'migrations'
and 'equivalences' apply on every topology; 'topologies' adds gaps for one
pair of servers, named as the suite names it (pg17→pg15).
The suite fails on any failure not listed here, and on a listed one that
starts passing, so the list can only shrink.

migrations.generated_expression_changed (before → a: The corpus's preserve query reads the generated column, which a correct migration recomputes (4 becomes 6), so no tool can satisfy it. Fixed in @akalforge/pg-conformance by preserving id and a only.
migrations.generated_expression_changed (after → be: The corpus's preserve query reads the generated column, which a correct migration recomputes (4 becomes 6), so no tool can satisfy it. Fixed in @akalforge/pg-conformance by preserving id and a only.

migrations.enum_label_removed_under_readers (before: PostgreSQL 15 renders a view's columns table-qualified (o.id) and 16+ does not, so every view reads as changed between the two: DBDiff recreates it and the state comparison reports its definition. Needs view definitions compared independently of the server's rendering, in DBDiff and in @akalforge/pg-conformance's state query.
